strings.aboutUsCompanyDescription: Agora Market was founded in 2024 as an innovative platform focused on high-quality C2C trading. We build a secure, transparent, and convenient online marketplace so both buyers and sellers can trade smoothly.
strings.aboutUsDesc: Learn about app information, version details and development team

strings.aboutUsFeatureSupportDescription: Round-the-clock support and a professional after-sales team are available to help resolve transaction issues.

strings.aboutUsMissionCardDescription: Build the safest and most convenient C2C marketplace so everyone can enjoy better online trading.
strings.aboutUsMissionDescription: Our mission is to provide comprehensive trading protection through advanced technology and human-centered service. The platform includes a credit rating system, multiple security checks, convenient payments, and professional support to help every order complete reliably.

strings.aboutUsVisionCardDescription: Become a leading C2C marketplace in Asia and build a trusted online trading ecosystem.

3.1 Registration eligibility
• You must be at least 18 years old and have full civil capacity
• You must provide true, accurate, and complete personal information

3.2 Account security
• You must properly protect your account name and password
• You are responsible for all activity under your account
• You should notify us immediately if you discover abnormal account activity

• We may modify this agreement
• The modified agreement will be published on the platform
• Continued use of the services means you agree to the modified agreement
strings.agreementSectionConductContent:
You agree to:
• Comply with all applicable laws and regulations
• Not publish illegal or non-compliant content
• Not engage in behavior that harms the platform or other users' rights

strings.agreementSectionContactContent:

strings.agreementSectionScopeContent: This agreement is between you and the C2C marketplace regarding use of our services. By using our services, you agree to all terms of this agreement.
strings.agreementSectionServicesContent:
Services we provide include but are not limited to:
• Product transaction services
• Payment and settlement services
• Logistics and delivery services
• Customer service
• Other related services

• Product information must be true and accurate

strings.helpCenterAddToHomeAnswer: After adding Agora to your home screen, you can open the market like an app without finding the Telegram link or browser bookmark each time. Choose the steps for your device below.

strings.helpCenterAndroidAddToHomeNote: If you are in the Telegram in-app browser, use the top-right menu to open the page in Chrome first.
strings.helpCenterAndroidAddToHomeStep2: If an Install or Add to Home Screen prompt appears, tap it directly.
strings.helpCenterAndroidAddToHomeStep3: If there is no prompt, tap the More menu in the top-right corner.
strings.helpCenterAndroidAddToHomeStep4: Choose Install app or Add to Home Screen, then confirm.

strings.helpCenterConnectChatGptAnswer: You can add the Agora MCP connector in ChatGPT Apps & Connectors. Go to the dedicated guide for setup steps, authorization, and usage limits.

strings.helpCenterDesktopInstallStep1: Open Agora Market in Chrome or Edge.
strings.helpCenterDesktopInstallStep2: Check whether there is an install icon on the right side of the address bar.

strings.helpCenterHowToApplyRefund: How to apply for a refund?
strings.helpCenterHowToApplyRefundAnswer: Click "Apply for Refund" on the order details page, fill in the refund reason and upload relevant supporting materials.
strings.helpCenterHowToChangePasswordAnswer: You can change your password in "Personal Center" → "Account Security". If you forgot your password, you can reset it via email or phone number.
strings.helpCenterHowToChangePhoneAnswer: Go to "Personal Center" → "Account Security", click "Change Phone Number", and follow the prompts to complete verification and change to a new phone number.
strings.helpCenterHowToInitiateTransactionAnswer: Select the product you want to buy, click "Buy Now", confirm order information and then initiate the transaction.
strings.helpCenterHowToViewTransactionHistoryAns: You can view all transaction history in "Personal Center" → "Transaction Records".
strings.helpCenterIosAddToHomeNote: If you cannot see Add to Home Screen, you are usually not in Safari. Choose Open in Safari first.
strings.helpCenterIosAddToHomeStep1: Open Agora in Safari first. Do not stay inside Telegram, LINE, or another in-app browser.
strings.helpCenterIosAddToHomeStep2: Tap the Share button at the bottom or top of Safari.
strings.helpCenterIosAddToHomeStep3: Choose Add to Home Screen from the menu.
strings.helpCenterIosAddToHomeStep4: Confirm the name is Agora Market, then tap Add.
strings.helpCenterIosAddToHomeTitle: iPhone / iPad: Add to Home Screen with Safari
strings.helpCenterLearnMoreSellerGuidelines: Want to learn more about seller guidelines
strings.helpCenterLearnMoreSellerGuidelinesAnswe: Click the button below to view the complete seller guidelines document.
strings.helpCenterOrderProcessingRequirements: What are the order processing requirements?
strings.helpCenterOrderProcessingRequirementsAns: Orders must be confirmed and shipped within 24 hours of receipt, and logistics information must be updated promptly after shipping. If unable to ship, buyers must be notified promptly and orders cancelled.
strings.helpCenterPlatformFeeAnswer: Base fee rate is 3%. Monthly sales reaching 1000 USDT enjoy 2.8% discount rate, 5000 USDT enjoy 2.5% discount rate, and 10000 USDT enjoy 2% discount rate.
strings.helpCenterProductListingRules: What are the product listing rules?
strings.helpCenterProductListingRulesAnswer: Product images must clearly show the actual product, product descriptions must be accurate, no false or misleading information, and prohibited products are strictly forbidden.

strings.helpCenterRefundProcessingTime: How long does it take for refunds to arrive?
strings.helpCenterRefundProcessingTimeAnswer: After refund application is approved, it usually takes 1-3 business days to return to the original payment account.

strings.privacySectionChildrenContent: Our services are for users aged 18 or older. If we discover that a child's information was collected by mistake, we will delete it promptly.
strings.privacySectionCollectionContent:
We collect information when needed to operate and protect the marketplace:
• Account and authentication data you provide, such as username, email, and linked provider identifiers
• Order, payment, wallet address, delivery, and support records created when you use a feature
• Technical and traffic data such as IP address, full User-Agent, device/browser signals, route, referrer, and timestamps
• Optional seller, buyer, or fulfillment information you choose to submit
We do not ask for or store wallet private keys or recovery phrases.

• Remember your preferences

• Provide personalized services
• Improve user experience
strings.privacySectionRetentionContent: Decryptable raw IP, full User-Agent, and related browser identifiers are retained for no more than 30 days and then scrubbed by scheduled cleanup. Pseudonymous traffic analytics rows may be kept for up to 90 days. The production application and uploaded media are currently configured in OCI us-phoenix-1 (Phoenix, Arizona, United States); service providers may process data in other locations where they operate.
strings.privacySectionRightsContent:
You have the following rights:
• Access your personal information
• Correct inaccurate information
• Delete personal information
• Withdraw consent
• Submit complaints and feedback
strings.privacySectionSecurityContent:
We use safeguards appropriate to the data:
• Sensitive traffic identifiers are encrypted at rest
• Plaintext access is restricted to direct local operations requests
• Granted and denied sensitive-access attempts are audited
• Network traffic is protected with HTTPS/TLS
• We do not store wallet private keys or recovery phrases
strings.privacySectionSharingContent:
We do not sell your personal information. We only share your information in the following situations:
• With your consent
• As required by law
• With service providers
• To protect our legitimate rights and interests
strings.privacySectionUpdatesContent: We may update this privacy policy. We will notify you of major changes. Continued use of our services means you agree to the updated privacy policy.
strings.privacySectionUseContent:
We use collected information to:
• Provide, secure, and improve services
• Process orders, transactions, and payments
• Provide customer support and service notifications
• Measure visits and product views
• Prevent fraud, abuse, and automated attacks
